theorems.name: Submission.idtp_ccd_sfv_approxTangentPlane_eq_span_ae
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (M V : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M → IsOpen V → μHE[n] ((R.carrier ∩ V) \ M) = 0 → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ V)), approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x = Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)
